summary.text: Rick Zbur was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 to represent the 51st Assembly District, and in July 2023 Speaker Robert Rivas appointed him Democratic Caucus Chair.

paragraphs.text: He was previously Executive Director of Equality California, an environmental lawyer, and a 20-year board member of the California League of Conservation Voters, serving as its president for six years.
Zbur grew up in a rural farming community in the Rio Grande Valley of New Mexico and graduated from Yale College and Harvard Law School; he moved to Los Angeles in 1985.
